findings.message: `MessageQueueTrigger.queue` is a public attribute holding the broker queue URI, and this renames it to `queue_uri` while re-pointing the `queue` name at the new trigger-queue value. Existing code that reads `trigger.queue` to get the broker URI does not fail - it now silently returns `None` (the ibm/mq test on line 244 shows exactly this flip). Keep `queue` forwarding to `queue_uri` with an `AirflowProviderDeprecationWarning` and pick a non-colliding attribute name for the triggerer-routing value, rather than reusing `queue` for a second meaning in the same release.

`trigger_queue` is added to the `:param:` list here, but nothing under `providers/common/messaging/docs/` changes in this PR - the `howto/trigger:MessageQueueTrigger` guide this docstring points at in its own `.. seealso::` still documents only `queue`/`scheme`. Add the `trigger_queue` explanation (and the `queue` -> `queue_uri` rename) to that guide in this PR, the way `deferring.rst` and `deadline-alerts.rst` were updated for the core half of the feature.
